import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    C = np.cos(params[0]*t)
    S = np.sin(params[0]*t)
    return (params[1]*C + params[2]*S)*(1 + params[3]*x + params[4]*v) + params[5]*(v**params[6]) + params[7]*x + params[8]*x*v
